cohort: 100 women aged 20-45 years with a history of cesarean delivery presenting with menstrual irregularities, pelvic pain, or infertility were evaluated.
finding: Cesarean scar defect (CSD) was identified in 89% of cases via TVS, with a niche depth >3 mm significantly associated with secondary infertility.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery correlated with irregular niche formation.
